labels.comments: Tammy was great with communication. Her airbnb is just what my granddaughter and I needed for sleeping over in Toronto. Very close to Danforth Music Hall. Clean and easy to find.
labels.note: Khách khen chủ nhà giao tiếp tốt, phòng sạch, dễ tìm và gần điểm đến; không có phàn nàn.

labels.comments: We had a wonderful one-month stay at Leroy and Michelle's place! The property was just as clean and tidy as it appeared in the pictures. Leroy and Michelle were incredibly accommodating hosts, making us feel right at home during my extended stay. We wouldn't hesitate to stay with them again in the future. Thanks for a great experience!
labels.note: Trải nghiệm lưu trú 1 tháng rất tốt, phòng sạch đúng ảnh, chủ nhà chu đáo.

labels.comments: Sergio and Andrea are fantastic host who go out of their way to make their guest feel comfortable and at home.
labels.note: Khách khen chủ nhà nhiệt tình, tạo cảm giác thoải mái như ở nhà.

labels.comments:
Arman was just the most outstanding host — responsive to all of our needs.
This is a wonderful, spacious house that can accommodate far more than the 4 people we brought.
The house is in a truly quiet, residential neighborhood only an 8 minute walk to Eglinton with its coffee shops and bakeries.
We definitely would consider returning.
labels.note: Khen chủ nhà phản hồi tốt, nhà rộng, khu yên tĩnh và tiện đi bộ.

labels.comments: The condo was in a great location and very nice, just like the photos. The host was very accommodating, responsive, and provided simple and clear instructions for check in and check out. Would highly recommend staying here!
labels.note: Khen vị trí đẹp, đúng ảnh, hướng dẫn nhận/trả phòng rõ ràng.

labels.comments: Great place! We stayed here for a month and really enjoyed it. Host was responsive and the location was super convenient!
labels.note: Khách hài lòng với kỳ nghỉ 1 tháng, chủ nhà phản hồi nhanh, vị trí thuận tiện.

labels.comments: I had so a easy going time here. There is so much to do whether its going to the board walk or just being a tourist with it being so closely located to things like the CN tower, Rogers center, Ripleys, etc. The place was very clean and had everything you needed. I definitely wish I stayed more than a single night. This is a great airbnb to live out of for a few weeks. Its also very cute aesthetically and you can see that there is a lot of thought and care into making this a comfortable space to anyone travelling down. It is also nice to know that they can be pet friendly if need be. Owners were very responsive and proactive. Very happy with this stay
labels.note: Khen vị trí trung tâm, phòng sạch đẹp và chủ nhà chu đáo; tiếc vì chỉ ở 1 đêm.

labels.comments: Everything was great! It is a big and spacious apartment in the basement of Henry’s house. Good facilities in the kitchen and a big plus with the washer and dryer. The neighborhood is really nice and beautiful with the victorian houses, very calm and peaceful. You can walk into downtown and the other areas of the city, but it takes about an hour - so if you’re not a big walker, it’s nice to take note of this. Henry was very good at responding to our questions and was always ready to help if anything was needed. We can definetely recomned this place, would come back!
labels.note: Khen phòng rộng, đầy đủ tiện nghi và chủ nhà nhiệt tình; việc đi bộ vào trung tâm mất 1 tiếng chỉ là thông tin lưu ý thêm, khách không phàn nàn bất tiện.

labels.comments: A beautiful home close to lots of amenities and great transport links. Very peaceful, lovely inside and outside spaces… amazing contemporary art and very beautifully furnished and fitted.  The host was a lovely lady and very responsive.
labels.note: Khen nhà đẹp, yên tĩnh, nội thất ấn tượng và chủ nhà thân thiện.

labels.comments: Trinity’s place was just what we were looking for - central, affordable, clean, and functional. Communication was quick, and the instructions were clear. Listing is accurate to the photos and description, I would definitely stay here again!
labels.note: Khen vị trí trung tâm, giá hợp lý, sạch sẽ và đúng mô tả.

labels.comments: I completely recommend this location. Ben was super responsive, provided clear and detailed instructions for getting in and using the place. It was very quiet and clean. I wholeheartedly recommend this bnb.
labels.note: Khen chủ nhà phản hồi nhanh, hướng dẫn rõ ràng, phòng sạch và yên tĩnh.

labels.comments: Clean. In-suite laundry a huge plus. Good view of the water and Toronto islands. Photos or video of which parking garage to use would be helpful.
labels.note: Khen phòng sạch, có máy giặt và view đẹp; câu cuối chỉ là góp ý bổ sung ảnh hướng dẫn nhà xe, không phàn nàn trải nghiệm.

labels.comments: I enjoyed my stay at this airbnb. Had no problems, host was very helpful. I found navigating the area was easy. Would recommend 💯
labels.note: Khách hài lòng, không gặp vấn đề gì, chủ nhà hỗ trợ tốt.

labels.comments: This is a great spot! The space is very modern and clean. Having access to the outdoor space was great for our family to hang out. The beds were very comfortable and it was great having a washer and dryer. We felt safe and the neighborhood is very quiet. Will stay here again!
labels.note: Khen không gian hiện đại, sạch sẽ, giường êm, khu an toàn và yên tĩnh.

labels.comments:
Fantastic place. Walking distant to the entertainment district. David was excellent. He was responsive and accommodating.
A excellent stay.
labels.note: Khen chỗ ở gần khu giải trí và chủ nhà David chu đáo.

labels.comments: Demetrios's place had all the basics for our stay. I was there just for one night but would go back if I need to be in Scarborough.  Quiet neighborhood and it felt like a safe area. he was very responsive and the room was very clean.
labels.note: Phòng sạch, đầy đủ tiện nghi cơ bản, khu an toàn yên tĩnh, chủ nhà phản hồi nhanh.

labels.comments: Alisa's place was nice. King St is a bit busy but the apartment is very quiet. The place was decently equiped. Small stuff could be addressed that were somewhat inconvenient like small TV, small trash cans, and lack of a nightstand. I'm sure they'll be addressed.
labels.note: Khen căn hộ đẹp và yên tĩnh, nhưng có chê một số bất tiện cụ thể (TV nhỏ, thùng rác nhỏ, thiếu tủ đầu giường).

labels.comments: The place was great, perfect location for enjoying Toronto.  Many things to do nearby, including shopping mall.  Host is very communicative and understanding of the visitor's request, even when I requested last minute changes.
labels.note: Khen vị trí hoàn hảo, nhiều tiện ích xung quanh và chủ nhà linh hoạt hỗ trợ.

labels.comments: Great location, many excellent restaurants in easy walking distance. Exactly as advertised and pictured, this is a nice, clean, stylish place. The parking spot is very useful in this bustling neighborhood. Hosts are great and accommodating. Highly recommended!
labels.note: Khen vị trí gần nhiều nhà hàng, phòng sạch đẹp đúng ảnh và có chỗ đỗ xe hữu ích.

labels.comments: Very well kept home, surprisingly very spacious ground floor. On arrival the house smelled very clean. Would recommend to anyone.
labels.note: Khen nhà sạch thơm, tầng trệt rộng rãi và được chăm chút kỹ.
